scope: Unreleased Rust source-layout inspection and exact coordinate-token patching shared by native and WASM; browser source layout no longer imports the YAML CST.

contracts.inspection: Strict bounded JSON, decoded duplicate keys, instance identities, coordinate bounds and logical scene groups. Inspect returns schemaVersion and actorCount only; it does not allocate draft sessions.
contracts.patch: Validates the complete batch before output, replaces changed coordinate scalar ranges only, and preserves other source bytes including BOM/CRLF, exponent notation, large unknown numbers and escaped UTF-16 surrogate code units.
contracts.numericCompatibility: Changed coordinates use JSON.stringify spelling, including decimal/exponent thresholds, subnormal values and exact ties. Numerically unchanged negative zero and exponent tokens are retained verbatim.
contracts.bridge: Validates plain finite JSON without executing getters, gates the optional source feature independently of the existing protocol-1 geometry interface, and rejects malformed source response shapes and paths.
contracts.host: Existing preview provenance, baseline hash and editor/dialog ownership remain in JavaScript. Applying a source patch changes only editor memory; normal Save retains its existing guarded persistence and conflict workflow.
contracts.remainingJavaScript: The broader scene model, World commands, backend general JSON/CST/YAML parsing and mobile YAML import rewrite remain unchanged.
contracts.browserDependencies: Removed the temporary public YAML browser-module route. The source-layout ESM graph now uses 8 modules and no YAML/CST dependency.

nativeCore.build: Offline locked debug binary in an isolated temporary Cargo target. Used by the full application check and source parity tests.

godot.scope: Existing build/runtime regressions enabled during the full application check.

offlinePackages.network: Fetch disabled; pinned Node license extracted read-only from the installed AppImage.
verified: v1/v2/v3 inspection and exact coordinate patches
Source draft creation, review/apply preparation and stale rejection
Existing geometry, draft undo/redo and saved-layout candidate
Stateless source operations do not consume 32 draft slots
Retained backend JSON/CST and YAML parsers

iterations.result: 8 passed, 1 test harness failure caused by treating WebAssembly.instantiate(Module) as its bytes overload; corrected the test only. Source parity and the full application check subsequently passed.

cleanup.temporaryStageAndCargoTarget: Removed after guarded synchronization; author workspace, preferences and installed application remain unchanged.

limitations: 19 skipped tests require native archive/mobile storage helper executables not supplied.
HTTP Chrome and isolated packaged ESM/WASM checks do not constitute native Tauri window/IPC or Android device acceptance.
No new installer, version bump, commit or push.
This migration covers source inspection and coordinate patches only; no scene fragments, multiple-file drafts, shared editor undo stack or migration of the complete scene model.
Literal lone surrogates cannot cross the raw Rust JSON string transport and return studio_core_request_invalid there; the public JavaScript wrapper retains scene_source_layout_invalid.
